about: Invented session lines for the goodbye reader's checks (#4537 slice 6, memory/goodbye_reading.py `parse_leaves`; #4991). The reader is AI; these are the goodbyes an AI might propose, each with the quote it copied, so the score is what the code's own checks keep. `goodbyes` must be kept; `must_not` must be refused. Behind DMBOT_PARTY_LEAVES: a wrong goodbye is costly, so the must-not set matters most.

goodbyes.quote: I say goodbye to the party
Selka parts ways with the company
Ulric stays behind in Brindle for good
Jessa heads home to her family
he bids farewell to the group

must_not.quote: Okthandom says goodbye to the innkeeper
Mira stays behind to guard the door
Brannick will leave the party at dawn
Are you leaving the party, Tavin
I'm going home for the night
must_not.why: a figure of speech and a trip

must_not.quote: Corvin heads home for the night
Halric does not leave the party
